purpose: Frozen data source registry for mechanism-v2.6. Every entry must pass its predeclared gate before waveform values are read.

ogw_cfrp_temperature_udam.v2_6_use: E7 healthy train/validation/test dates are immutable calibration provenance for D16 only. The quantizer, baseline pool, and OBS+BSS contract are frozen from E7. No new waveform extraction from udam is performed in v2.6.
ogw_cfrp_temperature_udam.pre_access_gate: Local archive MD5 must match official MD5. A source receipt with SHA-256 of the local file must be produced before any runner uses it.

ogw_cfrp_temperature_dam_d16.v2_6_use: One-shot blind confirmation on the same CFRP plate with a larger reversible disc (16mm). Replaces the retired D12. Uses the frozen E7 calibration (quantizer, baseline pool, stretch factors) without refitting.
pre_access_gate: capacity-aware terminal-hold pre-access test passed for all applicable (capacity, delta) cells
prohibited: substitution for a failed external confirmation
threshold or configuration selection after scoring

morpho_fod7.v2_6_use: Cross-structure confirmation. Fatigue degradation blocks on a composite structure independent of OGW. Provides block-level group bootstrap and independent replication.
pre_access_gate: Fresh v2.6 source receipt with SHA-256 of local file
Metadata-only schema gate: sortable fatigue-block path tokens, Healthy_Clamped/Healthy_Unclamped baseline tokens, Status attribute name, recoverable waveform paths and sample axes
Same-block repeat components must not cross splits
morpho_fod7.schema_failure_action: If schema gate fails, record schema_ineligible with reason. Do not score. COPV may be activated only under the frozen fallback rule.

coqtel_corrosion.v2_6_use: Schema qualification only. No ROC/AUC scoring because no official binary healthy-versus-corroded cutoff exists in the frozen documentation. The schema gate result itself is a valid artifact.
pre_access_gate: Fresh v2.6 source receipt with SHA-256 of local files
Metadata-only schema gate: EC_time array aligns with State_n groups, both campaign identifiers present, recoverable waveform paths and sample axes, adjacent states not treated as independent
coqtel_corrosion.v2_6_policy: If schema passes, report qualification success. If schema fails, record schema_ineligible. Under no circumstance invent a binary cutoff from temporal percentiles, visual trends, or signal scores.

longterm_2018_03.v2_6_use: Cross-period threshold stability assessment. Tests E8's March-2021-calibrated thresholds on an independent healthy period from 2018. Reports false calls/day and coverage only. No damage scoring.

longterm_2018_04.v2_6_use: Same as 2018_03. Two independent months provide a minimal cross-period stability check.

refusal_conditions: receipt already exists at the target path

immutable_boundary.ogw_d04_d24: Discovery set only. Cannot enter any v2.6 selection, confirmation, or conclusion path.
immutable_boundary.ogw_d12: Retired. v2.5 consumed it in a one-shot run that was invalidated. Must not be rerun, recast, or reused.
immutable_boundary.ogw_d16: Untouched before v2.6 freeze. One-shot only. Cannot be rerun after result inspection.
immutable_boundary.longterm_2021_05_06_2022_07_08: Ineligible for healthy-to-damage confirmation. May be used only under a separate future protocol, not v2.6.
